header.scope: Derived current whole HF front surface contacts only; every retained parent face touching local Z<-.15 is included complete. Original rear/contact cache is not read or changed.
header.proof: Each vertex uses original Float32 fixed/paw skin weights: P(theta)=C+Rx(theta)D. A barycentric parent point interpolates C and D after source-vertex posing. For every patch edge E=C+RxD, |E|²=|C|²+|D|²+2CxDx+2(Acos(theta)+Bsin(theta)); evaluate both endpoints and atan2(B,A) only if in the closed interval. Longest-edge subdivision uses dyadic barycentrics. The exact three-point MEB contains the whole posed planar patch, with radius<=maxEdge/sqrt(3)+padding. Moving and static edge budgets are explicitly recorded in the limits; no point radius is silently enlarged.

candidateLocalRefinement.method: Preserve original complete parent partition and refine only longest dyadic edges until original full-range limits plus four .25m pocket parent bounds hold on exact [0,.36] analytic maxima

seamConditioning.scope: One diagnosed thin true-wrist seam face: weld-consistent middle weight follows its geometric projection on the opposite raw source edge; no rest geometry/HF/UV/PBR edits or other-node smoothing
